# Page fixtures

HTML pages and JSON payloads that the Still True parser runs against. Each file keeps the `<head>` meta tags and every structured-data block of the real platform shape, with the exact nesting, `@context` form, quoting and value formats. Names are neutral: the shop is "Atelier Nord" (atelier-nord.example) and the venue is "Salle Rivage" (salle-rivage.example). Bodies are stripped to a heading.

Prices are in the units the page uses: decimal strings for most platforms, whole-number strings for Wix, cents for the Shopify `.js` endpoint. `eventStatus` is always the schema.org URL. Offer availability differs by platform: a bare `InStock` on the Eventbrite-shaped pages, `https://schema.org/InStock` or `OutOfStock` on the WooCommerce and Wix shapes.


| Fixture | Platform modelled | Contents | Real-world shape reproduced |
|---|---|---|---|
| `woocommerce-product-instock.html` | WooCommerce product page with Yoast graph | One Product in a `@graph`; offer `priceSpecification` array; price `48.00` EUR as a string; `https://schema.org/InStock`. Head meta `product:price:amount` `48.00`, `product:availability` `instock`. | Yoast `yoast-schema-graph--woo` block: `@graph` wrapper, `offers` as an array, `priceSpecification` as an array of `UnitPriceSpecification`, PHP-style escaped slashes (`\/`), HTML entities inside `category`. |
| `woocommerce-product-outofstock.html` | WooCommerce product page, out of stock | One Product; price `36.00` EUR; `https://schema.org/OutOfStock`. Head meta `product:availability` `oos`. | Same block as the in-stock fixture with the availability changed. The OutOfStock value and the `oos` meta spelling were not seen on a live page in this pass. |
| `wix-product.html` | Wix product page | One Product; `offers` as a single object (not an array); price `34` EUR as a string without decimals; `https://schema.org/InStock`; `@context` with a trailing slash; image array of `ImageObject` with `thumbnail`. Head meta `og:availability` `InStock`. | Wix store product block as emitted by the Wix store template. |
| `event-scheduled.html` | Eventbrite-style event page | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventScheduled`, `startDate` with `+01:00` offset, `Place` location, `offers` array holding one `AggregateOffer` with string `lowPrice`/`highPrice` (`18.0`, `32.5`), `priceCurrency` EUR, `availabilityStarts`/`availabilityEnds`/`validFrom` in Z form; plus `WebPage` with `speakable` and `BreadcrumbList` with relative `@id`. | Eventbrite event page: three ld+json blocks, `AggregateOffer` inside an `offers` array, `data-next-head` attributes, `og:type` `events.event`. |
| `event-cancelled.html` | Meetup-style event page, cancelled | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventCancelled`; name and description start with "CANCELLED"; `startDate` `+01:00`; `addressCountry` in lowercase (`fr`); `image` array; no offers. | Meetup event page: `Organization` (platform) + `BreadcrumbList` + `Event` + `RsvpAction` blocks, `data-next-head` on each script, escaped `\-` in the description. |
| `event-postponed.html` | Eventbrite-style event page, postponed by title | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventScheduled` (not `EventPostponed`); name "Postponed Further date will be announced"; one `AggregateOffer` at `24.0` EUR. | Eventbrite postponed listing: the postponement is only in the title and description, the status stays `EventScheduled`. |
| `event-postponed-eventstatus.html` | Event page with the schema.org `EventPostponed` value (extra fixture) | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventPostponed`; `startDate` `+01:00`; `AggregateOffer` at `24.0` EUR. | schema.org enumeration value. Not seen on a live page in this pass. |
| `event-rescheduled.html` | Event page rescheduled (schema.org shape) | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventRescheduled`; new `startDate` `2027-03-06T20:00:00+01:00`; `previousStartDate` `2027-02-27T20:00:00+01:00`; `AggregateOffer` at `21.0` EUR. | schema.org `previousStartDate` pattern on an Eventbrite-shaped page. Not seen on a live page in this pass. |
| `event-venue.html` | Meetup-style event page, scheduled (second event platform) | `Event` with `eventStatus` `EventScheduled`; `startDate` `2027-11-27T14:30:00+01:00`; `Place` location; no offers. | Meetup event page for an upcoming event, including the `Organization`, `BreadcrumbList` and `RsvpAction` blocks. |
| `no-structured-data.html` | Plain page, no structured data | Title, description and og/twitter meta only. The visible body text shows a price (`48,00 €`) with no markup. Expected result: no price from structured data. | Plain page with og meta and no ld+json. |
| `soft-404.html` | Shop homepage (redirect-to-home target) | `Organization`, `WebSite` (`http://schema.org` context, `SearchAction`), and an `ItemList` of three `Product` references with no `offers`. Expected: no price or availability from the ItemList. | Shopify homepage: `http://schema.org` context, `\/`-escaped URLs, `ItemList` of product references without offers. |
| `malformed-jsonld.html` | Product page with one invalid ld+json block | Block 0 is a `Product` with a trailing comma after the `url` property and after the `offers` object (invalid JSON). Block 1 is a valid `Organization`. Exactly one block fails to parse. | Product JSON-LD with trailing commas, as found on live pages. `@context` `https://schema.org/` with trailing slash. |
| `shopify-product-instock.html` | Shopify product page (Online Store 2.0 theme) | `Product` JSON-LD from Liquid's `json` filter (escaped slashes), one `Offer` at `49.0` EUR as a number, `http://schema.org/InStock`; `og:price:amount` `49,00`; `ShopifyAnalytics` marker. | Shopify themes' structured data. |
| `shopify-product-instock.js.json` | Shopify `/products/<handle>.js` | Prices in cents (`4900`), three variants, two `available`. | The public product endpoint every Shopify store serves. |
| `shopify-product-soldout.html`, `.js.json` | Shopify, sold out | `OutOfStock`; the only variant has `available: false`. | |
| `shopify-product-variants.html`, `.js.json` | Shopify `ProductGroup` with `hasVariant` | Two variants at `24.00` (out of stock) and `32.00` (in stock). | Shopify's newer `structured_data` filter. |
